defs.def: thick stiff paper 卡片纸；厚纸片；薄纸板
a small piece of stiff paper or plastic with information on it, especially information about sb's identity （尤指显示个人资料的）卡片

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: This means. for example，that a scammer could call you from what looks to be a familiar number and talk to you using a voice that sounds exactly like your bank teller 's，ricking you into "confirming " your address，mother's name，and card number.
ex.t: 这意味着，比如说，一个骗子可以给你打电话 从一个看起来熟悉的号码 并用一个声音和你说话 听起来就像你的银行出纳的，让你"确认"你的地址，母亲的名字，和卡片号码。

ex.s: The card dropped off into a lake by accident.
ex.t: 卡不小心掉进了湖里。

ex.s: My mother was not afraid of Mrs Calloway She wished me to have my own library card to check out books for myself.
ex.t: 我妈妈不害怕Calloway太太她希望我有自己的借书证可以自己借书。

defs.def: 如果你需要再和我联系，这是我的名片。

ex.s: Over the weekend， he worked through the piles of handmade cards at his house． One card from a student stood out to him． It read： "Mr． Haze，you are my sunshine．"
ex.t: 整个周末，他在家翻看那一堆手写卡片。一张学生的卡片让他眼前一亮。上面写着：“黑兹先生，你是我的阳光。”

ex.s: Similarly, if you speak only Chinese, receiving a card in Swedish takes part of the fun away.
ex.t: 同样地，如果你只会说中文，收到一张瑞典语的卡片会少了一些乐趣。

ex.s: If your student ID card no longer works or has been damaged, or if you have changed your personal or programme details, you should call into the Student Administration Centre （SAC） to request a new one.
ex.t: 如果你的学生证失效或损坏，或者你更改了个人或课程信息，你应到学生事务中心（SAC）申请补办。

ex.s: Please be aware that you will not receive this smart card during Welcome Week if you do not upload your image online by 4 September 2020.
ex.t: 请注意如果你不在2020年9月4日之前在线上传你的照片你在迎新周期间将不会收到这张智能卡。

ex.s: If your card has been reported to the Police as stolen, please also call into the SAC to request a replacement, bringing with you a copy of your Police Crime Report paperwork.
ex.t: 如果你的卡已被报警称被盗，请也到SAC申请补发，并带上一份警方报案文件的复印件。

ex.s: If your card has been lost, a fee of £5 is charged for the production of a replacement card.
ex.t: 如果你的卡丢失，补发卡将收取5英镑费用。

defs.def: a small piece of plastic, especially one given by a bank or shop/store, used for buying things or obtaining money 信用卡；现金卡；储值卡

ex.s: I don’t have a credit card.
ex.t: 我没有信用卡。

ex.s: The（2）     moment was quickly followed by mental math． How much time and money would it cost to replace the（3）     of that little wallet？ The credit cards， the driver's license， the cash， all lost to the bus．
ex.t: （2）____的那一刻紧接着便是心算。更换那个小钱包里的（3）____需要花费多少时间和金钱？信用卡、驾照、现金，全都落在了公交车上。

ex.s: I was really surprised when a bank contacted me with a credit card offer.
ex.t: 当一家银行联系我提供信用卡时，我真的感到很惊讶。

ex.s: Of course, I would like to have more freedom with money and no doubt I will be getting a credit card at some point, but I currently don’t have a steady income, so getting a credit card might tempt me to spend more money than I have!
ex.t: 当然，我希望在花钱方面有更多的自由，毫无疑问，我会在某个时候拿到一张信用卡，但我目前没有稳定的收入，所以拿到信用卡可能会诱惑我花比拥有更多的钱！

ex.s: The card fails to work properly.
ex.t: 这张卡无法正常工作。

ex.s: I jumped out of the car, made a mad run for the machine, and popped my card in, only to read the message: "Out of order.
ex.t: 我跳下车，拼命跑向机器，把卡插进去，却看到提示：“故障停用。”

ex.s: Please ensure that you bring your existing card with you.
